name: Almogim Holdings Ltd.
summary: Almogim Holdings Ltd. develops, sells, and operates of real estate properties in Israel and internationally. It focuses on the development, construction, marketing, sale, and rental of residential neighborhoods and commercial complexes; construction, rental, and operation of residential complexes for young people; and provision of property management services. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Tirat Carmel, Israel.
